question: If each vowel in the word TEACHING is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order and then arrange the letters in alphabetical order, then which of the following letters will be fourth from the right in the group of letters thus formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

If each vowel in the word TEACHING is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order and then arrange the letters in alphabetical order,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03e0d6c35ae5ba929c651b26b6d0d95908a82747e3c0a11415535eb170d2f184.png] 

Then, **I **will be fourth from the right in the group of letters thus formed.
